title: TCG: Stellar Crown
description: Terapagos and the Stellar Tera type debut!

questions.question: Which Pokémon ex headlines the set?
questions.explanation: Terapagos ex, including Terastal forms, is the centerpiece of the set.

questions.question: Stellar Crown introduces the Stellar Tera type on Pokémon ex cards.
questions.explanation: Stellar Tera Pokémon ex provide bonus damage against opposing ex Pokémon and pull from any type of Energy.

questions.question: Which competitive Stage 2 ex gained traction from Stellar Crown?
questions.explanation: Hydrapple ex's Syrupy Hold ability became central to a new top deck.

questions.question: Lacey debuts as a Supporter in Stellar Crown.
questions.explanation: Lacey from Indigo Disk DLC debuts as a powerful draw Supporter card.

questions.question: Approximately how many cards are in the Stellar Crown set?
questions.explanation: Stellar Crown has 175 cards including secret rares.

questions.question: Which other Tera-typed legendary appears in Stellar Crown?
questions.explanation: Hydreigon ex appears as a notable powerful ex in Stellar Crown.

questions.question: Terapagos ex has both a base ex and a Terastal Form ex in this set.
questions.explanation: Terapagos ex appears in normal form and as Terapagos ex Terastal Form (Stellar Tera).

questions.question: Which ACE SPEC card from Stellar Crown is widely used?
questions.explanation: Neutralization Zone Stadium nullifies ex-bonus prizes — a powerful disruption tool.

questions.question: Stellar Crown is the seventh main SV expansion.
questions.explanation: Stellar Crown is the 7th main set in the Scarlet & Violet era.
